subject: Mental Models
title: Pre-Mortem Analysis
description: A short lesson to help you apply Pre-Mortem Analysis.

hook.text: Imagine your project failed spectacularly. Now work backward and explain why.

buildup.text: A pre-mortem inverts the usual approach. Instead of asking what could go wrong, you assume failure and find the causes.

discovery.text: Gary Klein invented the pre-mortem in 1998.

twist.text: People who assume success plan optimistically.

climax.text: Before launching any important plan, run a pre-mortem.

punchline.text: Assume failure first. Then prevent the causes.
